scope: Measured in one simulator and map. Historical and fresh cohorts are specified separately. No automatic deployment.

temporal_confirmations.scope: Retrospective RGB-only confirmation analysis. First label initializes the state; after that, require K consecutive raw labels before changing it. Report the full fixed set of K; no model selection or runtime change. Confirmed accuracy includes all stable 20-second post-ack segments.

audit_reproduction.replay_notes: 64 audit sampling seeds, identical eligible captured pixels and priority score, no independent new drives

relative_queue_parity.models: historical 824-row RF, its verified centers; separate from the spatial 1728-row comparative study

enriched_night.site_design: 23 targeted calibration poses in 3 site families and 15 evaluation poses in 4 different families; same simulator. Includes reference sites.

moving_depth_codes.scope: Post-hoc localization on 12 same-route laps. Pooled pixel IoU for each depth-code band; no physical distance calibration. Every frame reproduces original paired TP/FP/FN.

fresh_f1_largest_error.rule: Highest absolute refreshed f1 RF error among all defined fresh held images, selected after evaluation. Original 4-frame model batch and per-pixel target are verified.

frozen_alarm_road_link_transfer.method: Supplementary evaluation of previously frozen f0 spatial RF thresholds. Study location selection used road geometry. Labels in other analyses were opened before this follow-up was chosen.

fresh_stationary_integrity.note: Both input hashes at capture time for training, plus depth/instance hashes taken on readback. The held capture also logged its auxiliary hashes at acquisition.

freeze.policy: One GP configuration from prior f0 experiment. RF and GP use same all X56, exact same 1112 labels. Interval scales fixed at development 90% empirical quantile on 576 rows, also used in model selection. No coverage guarantee across sites.

paired_motion_spatial_sensitivity.design: Post-hoc circle of paired 100 m blocks, sampled in contiguous groups of 3 with both laps retained. Conditional on the observed circuit and schedule. Does not change the predeclared pooled verdict or quantify new-map uncertainty.

cluster_within_pose_shuffle.method: Permute frozen assignments among the 12 conditions separately at each pose. The same draws are used for both methods. This retains per-pose center counts and breaks their association with the paired weather/hour labels. Quantiles describe the shuffle null and are not cross-map uncertainty.

straight_road_signed_examples.rule: Show the most over- and under-estimated straight poses in the fixed 13h study under common sunny weather.

crosswalk_marking_replay.question: Following a single extreme frame, does the same material error recur on other recorded drives? Existing observations reused. Correlated pixels and consecutive frames.

crosswalk_oracle_error_budget.definition: For each frame keep all TP and FN and remove only lane FP on a GT crosswalk. Frames are equally weighted. This quantifies an oracle intervention on a single false-positive class.
